select p.project_id, p.contract_number, p.contract_num, p.tenant_id, p.contract_name, p.cs_number, (select b.bp_name from hls_bp_master b where b.bp_id = p.tenant_id)tenant_id_n, ( SELECT e.description FROM sys_user e WHERE e.user_id = p.host_project_manager ) host_project_manager_n, ( SELECT u.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit u WHERE u.unit_id = p.unit_id ) unit_id_n from prj_project p

SELECT t.contract_id, t.contract_name, t.contract_number, c.cashflow_id, c.due_date, c.times, c.due_amount, c.principal, c.interest, t.tenant_id, ( SELECT b.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master b WHERE b.bp_id = t.tenant_id ) tenant_id_n, nvl(c.received_amount, 0) received_amount, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND trunc(c.due_date) < trunc(sysdate) THEN '逾期' ELSE '未逾期' END ) overdue_status_n, c.cf_item, ( CASE WHEN c.cf_item = 1 THEN '租金' ELSE '手续费' END ) AS cf_item_n, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND trunc(c.due_date) < trunc(sysdate) THEN CEIL((sysdate-c.due_date)) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_days, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND trunc(c.due_date) < trunc(sysdate) THEN c.due_amount - nvl(c.received_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_amounts, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND trunc(c.due_date) < trunc(sysdate)THEN c.interest - nvl(c.received_interest, 0) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_interest_amount, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND trunc(c.due_date) < trunc(sysdate) THEN c.principal - nvl(c.received_principal, 0) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_principal_amount FROM con_contract t, con_contract_cashflow c
t.contract_id = c.contract_id AND c.cf_item IN (1, 3) AND c.cf_status != 'BLOCK' and t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.data_class = 'NORMAL' and t.contract_status in('INCEPT','PENDING')

SELECT t.contract_id, t.contract_name, t.contract_number, c.cashflow_id, c.due_date, c.times, c.due_amount, c.principal, c.interest, t.tenant_id, ( SELECT b.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master b WHERE b.bp_id = t.tenant_id ) tenant_id_n, nvl(c.received_amount, 0) received_amount, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND c.due_date < sysdate THEN '逾期' ELSE '未逾期' END ) overdue_status_n, c.cf_item, ( CASE WHEN c.cf_item = 1 THEN '租金' ELSE '手续费' END ) AS cf_item_n, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND c.due_date < sysdate THEN CEIL((sysdate-c.due_date)) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_days, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND c.due_date < sysdate THEN c.due_amount - nvl(c.received_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_amounts, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND c.due_date < sysdate THEN c.interest - nvl(c.received_interest, 0) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_interest_amount, ( CASE WHEN c.due_amount != nvl(c.received_amount, 0) AND c.due_date < sysdate THEN c.principal - nvl(c.received_principal, 0) ELSE 0 END ) overdue_principal_amount, c.WRITE_OFF_FLAG FROM con_contract t, con_contract_cashflow c
t.contract_id = c.contract_id AND c.cf_item IN (1, 3) AND c.cf_status != 'BLOCK' and t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.data_class = 'NORMAL' and t.contract_status in('INCEPT','PENDING')
